Definition: from the base of G3674 and G5424; like-minded, i.e. harmonious:--of one mind.
BiblicalUsage: In Scripture, homóphrōn means of one mind. It occurs just once, in 1 Peter.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is simple here: homóphrōn means of one mind, and I do not stretch it further.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
